General Education Program Requirements

National University's General Education Program consists of a minimum of 69 quarter (46 semester) units in eight different areas. Of these, at least 4.5 quarter units (3 semester units) must be upper-division courses, and 4.5 quarter units (3 semester units) must focus on diversity-enriched coursework. Students can apply up to 13.5 quarter units (9 semester units) of upper-division coursework towards their general education requirements.

CSU General Education Breadth, IGETC and Cal-GETC

National University accepts the following General Education certifications: California State University (CSU) General Education Breadth, the Inter-Segmental General Education Transfer Curriculum (IGETC), or the California General Education Transfer Curriculum (Cal-GETC). All certification requirements for CSU General Education Breadth, IGETC or Cal-GETC must be completed and certified prior to transfer to National University. Partial certifications are not accepted.


Students transferring with full certifications are required to take at least one upper-division general education course at National to fulfill the unit requirements. Certain degree programs may require additional upper-division general education courses; refer to specific Major Articulation Agreements for details. Students must submit an official transcript that includes the certification, or a separate certification form from the community college attended. For more information on NU’s General Education program, please see NU’s current catalog.
